evals.prompt: Use only the test-design-session wrapper. A current durable workflow-plan routes an approved full-orchestrated payment-state change into test design. Security and data scenario lanes must fan out independently, so ROUTING-PHASE-CONTROL resolves phase_control=required. Produce only test-design outputs and stop before planning.
evals.expected_output: A test-design-only result that writes an approved scenario-focused test-plan.md, updates the current master, creates or updates workflow-plans/test-design.md because phase_control=required, and stops before tasks.md or implementation.
expectations: The output computes durable_master_control=present and phase_control=required from the stated fan-out reason before choosing workflow-control writes.
The output creates stable TD-* scenarios with proof levels, pass/fail observables, fail-before expectations, determinism constraints, and reopen targets.
The output updates both current master control and the required phase file with the same routing identity.
The output stops before planning, tasks.md, tests, production code, migrations, or generated artifacts.
The output consumes canonical phase, typed-state, and handoff owners without inventing a skill-local state matrix, read order, authorization paragraph, or handoff template.

evals.prompt: Use only the test-design-session wrapper. evals.expected_output: A typed no-test-plan decision recorded in the existing master with phase_control=not_required, no test-plan.md or workflow-plans/test-design.md creation, and a planning handoff.
expectations: The output computes durable_master_control=present and phase_control=not_required instead of treating the test-design checkpoint as a phase-file trigger.
The output records test-plan.md artifact_expectation=not_expected, artifact_state=absent, waiver_disposition=none, and record_validity=current with trigger rationale and reopen condition.
The output updates only the existing master and does not create workflow-plans/test-design.md.
